# JsMind

::: warning Preview version
The jsMind V2 programming API is currently a preview. The API will change in later updates. Please check this documentation anytime for the interface that is current.
:::

The default export of the `jsmind` package. In the UMD build it is also available as the global `jsMind`.

This page is generated from the published typings `dist/jsmind.d.ts` with TypeDoc.

## JsMind {#JsMind}

*Class*

Main class for jsMind mind map operations.

### mind {#JsMind.mind}

```ts
mind: JmMind | null
```

The currently opened mind map, or null if none is open.

### options {#JsMind.options}

```ts
options: JsMindOptions
```

The options for this jsMind instance.

### Mind {#JsMind.Mind}

```ts
static Mind: typeof JmMind
```

The mind map model class. Construct a map with `new jsMind.Mind()`, then
pass it to [JsMind.open](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.open).

### NodeSide {#JsMind.NodeSide}

```ts
static NodeSide: { Center: 0; SideA: 1; SideB: -1 }
```

Node side values used when placing a node to the left, right, or center.
Same object as the `JmNodeSide` enumeration in the typings.

### Serializer {#JsMind.Serializer}

```ts
static Serializer: typeof JmMindSerializerFactory
```

Factory for serializers. `jsMind.Serializer.create('json')` and
`jsMind.Serializer.create('freemind')` are the supported formats.

### commands {#JsMind.commands}

```ts
get commands(): JmCommander
```

Commands that change what is displayed - export, zoom - without changing
the map.

**Remarks**

Reachable from outside so that the caller can hold on to it: a shell, a
toolbar button or a keyboard shortcut keeps this reference and calls it,
instead of going through the instance every time.

### close {#JsMind.close}

```ts
close(): void
```

Closes the current mind map, if one is open.

After `close`, [JsMind.mind](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.mind) is `null` until you [JsMind.open](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.open) another map.

### exportImage {#JsMind.exportImage}

```ts
exportImage(options?: JmExportImageOptions): Promise<JmExportImageResult>
```

Renders the open mind map to an image.

The size is the rendered content's own size: whitespace inside the
container is part of the picture, and a map larger than its container is
not cropped.

**Returns:** The encoded image, as a Blob, plus its pixel dimensions.

**Throws**

- `JsMindError` If no mind map is open, or if the browser
cannot encode the result.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `options` (optional) | [JmExportImageOptions](/en/reference/api/export#JmExportImageOptions) | Scale, format, quality and background transparency. Defaults to PNG at 2x. |

### open {#JsMind.open}

```ts
open(mind: JmMind): Promise<void>
```

Opens a mind map.

**Remarks**

Opening replaces whatever is displayed. A map that is already open is
closed first, which drops its rendered nodes and its observer: without
that, opening a second map on the same view stacks it on top of the
first, and opening the map that is already open keeps rendering the
previous style.

Opened is also when the instance's viewport mode is applied: an instance
created without options owns the box from here on - `overflow` is already
the viewport's, and the map starts at the identity rather than at the
corner the previous one was left at. An instance created with
`{ view: { viewportMode: 'native' } }` keeps native scrolling, and its
[JsMind.commands](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.commands) refuse to move the map.

**Returns:** A promise that resolves when the mind map has been opened.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `mind` | [JmMind](/en/reference/api/mind#JmMind) | The mind map instance to open. |

### serialize {#JsMind.serialize}

```ts
serialize(): string
```

Serializes the current mind map to JSON.

**Returns:** JSON string representation of the mind map.

**Throws**

- `Error` If no mind map is open or serialization fails.

### create {#JsMind.create}

```ts
static create(container: string | HTMLElement, options?: JsMindOptionsInput): Promise<JsMind>
```

Creates a jsMind instance and attaches its view to a container.

**Returns:** A promise that resolves to the new instance. No mind map is open yet;
call [JsMind.open](/en/reference/api/jsmind#JsMind.open) with a [JmMind](/en/reference/api/mind#JmMind) to display one.

**Parameters**

| Name | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `container` | string \| `HTMLElement` | The container element, or the id of an element in the document. |
| `options` (optional) | [JsMindOptionsInput](/en/reference/api/options#JsMindOptionsInput) | Configuration for the instance. Every group and every field in it may be omitted, and omitted ones use the library defaults - which include taking the container's box over with the transform viewport. `{ view: { viewportMode: 'native' } }` keeps native scrolling instead, and is what a host without its own gestures wants for a map larger than its box. |
